title: Core's sampling law: penalties-free selection, top-k, top-p, min-p and Core's draws
description: The FP64 mirror of token-sampling's device sampler: rank order with the lower id first, Core's Philox draw at each output position, and the rejection-sampling predictions of a verify round. The reference every sampler plugin is compared with. Its device form runs the same law over logits rows in torch (code/device_law.py), the draw from Core's Philox on the host; inside captured decode rounds (rounds:sampler) its CUDA sampler (crit's kernel token-sampling, built for the device by crit's kernel build) draws drafts with their sparse laws and predicts every verify column by rejection sampling with Core's draws, no host value inside (code/device_rounds.py).

rounds.description: what samples inside captured decode rounds (rounds:sampler): native, crit's kernel token-sampling built for the device (where it does not build, the torch law, with a warning and the kernel's recorded fallback), or the torch law over sorted rows (slower)

kernels.name: token-sampling
kernels.fallback: the torch law over sorted rows (code/device_rounds.py), capture-safe and slower
